STATE OF CALIFORNIA—HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES AGENCY
DEPARTMENT OF SOCIAL SERVICES
State Hearings Division
PO Box 944243, MS 9-17-442 Sacramento, CA 94244-2430
PHONE: 800-743-8525 FAX: 1-833-281-0905

JENNIFER TROIA
DIRECTOR

GAVIN NEWSOM
GOVERNOR

PROPOSED DISMISSAL (NON-HEARABLE ISSUE)
For a free interpretation of this letter please call 800-743-8525.

May 15, 2026
RE: SHN-XXXXXXX55

This letter is to let you know that State Hearings intends to dismiss your request for a hearing that you filed on May 03, 2026.

The reason we intend to dismiss your request without a hearing and written decision is because it is not the type of issue that can be heard by State Hearings. The specific reason is:

You indicated in your hearing request that you would like a hearing to dispute an in action by the Department of Health Care Service on a request for reimbursement. You indicated that claims must be reimbursed or formally contested within 30 calendar days of receipt.

A State Hearing is available to an applicant for or recipient of a California Department of Social Services or the Department of Health Care Services administered aid, who is dissatisfied with any action of the county department, the Department of Health Services or any person or organization acting on behalf of the county or the Department of Health Services relating to the application for or receipt of the aid.

The Department indicated that there has been no denials of your request for reimbursement and your claim is still being reviewed.

Pursuant to All Plan Letter 07-002, completed claims for reimbursement will need to be adjudicated within 120 days of receipt of the beneficiary's completed claim for Medi-Cal covered expenses incurred. You indicated that your claim was filed on March 27, 2026. Therefore, the Department has until July 27, 2026 to adjudicate the claim. At this time, there is insufficient information to find that your request for a state hearing is within the jurisdiction of a state hearing and as such will be dismissed. If you have received a Notice of Action or have additional information, please contact the State Hearing Division.

You have 15 days from the date of this letter to tell us why your appeal should not be dismissed. If you already have a hearing date, we will postpone that date while we wait for your response.

• If you provide a good reason, we will schedule a hearing.
034 – Proposed Dismissal – Rev 03/2022 (English)

• If you contact us within 15 days, but fail to provide a good reason, your case will be closed;
you will get a final dismissal letter.

• If you do not contact us within 15 days, your case will be closed; you will not get another
letter from us.

• If you respond after 15 days, and we have not yet closed your case, we may choose to
consider your response, but you will have to show good cause for your late response.

You can send documents supporting why your appeal should not be dismissed by one of the ways
below.

If you have any questions about this letter you may call 800-743-8525, or contact the State Hearings
Division in one of the ways below:

• Online Appeals Account: https://acms.dss.ca.gov/acms/
• Email: ScopeOfBenefits@dss.ca.gov
• Fax Number: 833-281-0903
• Mail To: (Allow at least 5 days for mailing. Keep your originals.)
State Hearings Division
PO Box 944243, MS 9-17-433, Sacramento, CA 94244-2430

IMPORTANT MESSAGE

If you disagree with the dismissal decision you can ask for court review within one year of the date
you got the dismissal letter. To ask for court review, you must file a "petition" in Superior Court.
The law about this is found at California Code of Civil Procedure section 1094.5. You will not have
to pay court filing fees. If you win in court, and had a lawyer represent you, you may be able to
get reasonable attorney's fees and costs. You may contact your nearest Legal Aid office for
assistance.

If you have any questions about this letter, you may call 800-743-8525, or contact the State Hearings
Division at one of the ways above.

STATE HEARINGS DIVISION

CC:

DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH CARE SERVICES
